stage: regular ClassII United States Senate general election

qualified_writein_primary_sources.authorship: Georgia SOS Elections Division; FINAL LIST OF CERTIFIED WRITE-IN CANDIDATES

withdrawal_review.status: No Senate withdrawal/disqualification notice observed in examined October county sample-ballot contexts or SOS candidate search. Complete statewide withdrawal register not acquired; no universal absence claim.

runoff.trigger: No candidate receives a majority of valid votes cast for Senate; top two under OCGA21-2-501; strictly greater than half, not two-party margin alone
runoff.legal_label: Statute calls runoff a continuation for office/eligibility; counting/research must keep separate election-stage identity and fresh totals
runoff.tie: November tie gives no majority; do not declare a winner. If election fails and cannot be cured by runoff, OCGA21-2-504 requires a special election; no coin toss/date invented.

rules.poll_hours: November3 general:7am-7pm Eastern Standard Time (UTC-5), with anyone in line at close entitled to vote; nominal close2026-11-04T00:00:00Z. Statutory8pm exception for certain city general elections is not automatic for this statewide Senate race. Court-extended hours must be separately observed and provisional ballots segregated.
rules.ordinary_absentee_receipt: Received by election officials by close of polls November3, not merely postmarked; verify actual court order for any exception.
rules.uocava: Eligible federal military/overseas ballots postmarked by election date and received by November6 under OCGA21-2-386(a)(1)(G); rule183-1-14-.10 also recognizes otherwise proper eligible mailed/courier ballots without a postmark received within stated three-day period. Do not apply ordinary mail deadline to this pool or assume all late mail qualifies.
rules.cure_provisional: Detailed SOS2026 calendar:November6 5pm documentation/cure deadline; only timely, eligible and validated ballots count. Rule183-1-12-.18 keeps provisional ballots separate; out-of-precinct voting after5pm has specific sworn-statement conditions, and extended-hour ballots are a distinct category.
rules.county_certification: Detailed SOS2026 calendar:November9 5pm; OCGA21-2-493(k) Monday following election, promptly transmitted to SOS.
rules.state_certification: Detailed SOS2026 calendar:November20 for federal/statewide returns; OCGA21-2-499/497. Source official flag and asOf are not certification dates.
rules.runoff_deadlines: December1 scheduled runoff;December4 documentation/cure/UOCAVA;December7 5pm county certification;December18 state certification in detailed calendar. Court postponement could alter stage schedule.
rules.senate_recount: OCGA21-2-495(c):written losing-candidate request within two business days after certification if difference is <=0.5% of total office votes, also applies runoff qualification; statewide request to SOS. Error/discrepancy recount/recanvass authority is separate. SignedSB3EX2026 section2 mandatory manual recount covers its enumerated state executive offices, NOT United States Senate.
rules.reporting: Current2026 rule183-1-12-.12(d) specifies transmission checkpoints at1/3,2/3,all precincts for state-office results and requires unofficial federal/state contested totals before concluding night tabulation absent notice/consultation. This is a transmission rule, not measured public API cadence. Provisional/UOCAVA exceptions remain.
rules.writein_validity: Current rule183-1-12-.12(b)(8) excludes unqualified write-ins from certified consolidated returns; generic Write-in and Unresolved Write-In are categories, not named valid candidates. Source categories are not silently distributed.
rules.court_and_vintage: Court S25A0362/S25A0490 June10,2025 invalidated four challenged2024 rules and remanded other standing/rule issues. Current compiled rules explicitly note2024 repeals/reversion, then July21,2026 filing/August10 amendment. Do not activate void2024 hand-count/examination authority from an old guide or treat a current posted PDF as authority to withhold mandatory statutory certification.
rules.calendar_conflict: County-hosted detailed SOS calendar contains reconciliation dates Dec3/Dec31, while rule says within30days following actual certification; these are not equivalent to Nov9/Dec7 plus30days. Retain calendar text; use actual certification plus operative rule for deadline arithmetic. PDF source clocks often omit timezone; do not invent it.
rules.current_local_poll_orders: Bounded current primary-source search on October18 found no November3 county/precinct extension order; future orders cannot be pre-cleared. Historical extensions are not operative2026 exceptions.
